question: What bodily form results from constant practice of this yoga?
premises: Constant practice of yoga is the means
A resulting bodily form is stated
The form is described as that of sixteen years
inference: Through constant yogic practice one attains the form of a sixteen-year-old
uncertainties: dvi-aṣṭa-varṣa-ākṛtiḥ is interpreted as a sixteen-year-old form
plain_english: Through constant yogic practice, one attains the form of a sixteen-year-old.
